services.desc: Make Museum of the Rockies your premier destination in Bozeman for memorable gatherings of every kind. From graduations and networking meetings to staff retreats, award ceremonies, and private celebrations, the museum offers an inspiring setting surrounded by science, history, and discovery. Elevate your guests’ experience with options like a private show in the Taylor Planetarium or after-hours access to our exhibition halls, including the awe-inspiring Siebel Dinosaur Complex, the welcoming Paugh History Hall, and our rotating special exhibitions. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Museum of the Rockies offers fantastic STEAM-themed camps that immerse students in paleontology, history, the natural sciences, art, physics, and Yellowstone National Park, among other topics, all summer long. Learn from enthusiastic instructors and museum experts while taking in all that MOR has to offer as you stay active, make new friends, spend time outside, explore our exhibits, and create lasting memories. Camps fill up fast, so register quickly. services.name: View Exhibit
services.desc: Museum of the Rockies (MOR) hosts a mix of primary and traveling exhibitions, including one of the most extensive and significant collections of dinosaur fossils in North America. The massive skeleton of 'Montana's T. rex' and other prehistoric animals stand as a testament to the giants that once ruled these lands 66

services.name: Early Learning and Youth Programs
services.desc: MOR is dedicated to serving all ages, starting as young as 0! Our standards-aligned, high-quality early learning programming nurtures the minds of young children by engaging them with hands-on learning and sensory exploration. We work to foster a sense of community among children and their caregivers. MOR has been named Bozeman's Best Place for Family Fun every year since 2013 thanks to our early learning classes and events. Discover fun sensory awareness activities designed for newborns up to 18 months old. Engage with your baby through interactive shared reading, singing, movement, and exploration experiences.
